en: The image shows a picturesque town square with an imposing Gothic cathedral featuring two tall spires as the main focus. The structure has dark stonework and ornate details, with a pointed red-roofed section at its front and an arched entrance. Adjacent are older European-style buildings with steep-pitched roofs, and the foreground is a cobbled square with a few people walking. Some trees provide greenery on the left. The sky is bright and clear, indicating daytime.
